spacecraft.label: Spacecraft cabin
spacecraft.note: Nominal 21% O2 / 14.7 psia cabin (exploration vehicles may adopt 8.2 psia / 34%).

mars.label: Mars base
mars.note: Assumed same exploration atmosphere as lunar base (no NASA Mars habitat standard in sources), 0.38 g.

rover.label: Pressurized rover
rover.note: 8.2 psia / 34% O2 exploration atmosphere named in ACME BRE objectives; within the brief's '30%+ at <=10.2 psi'.
